description: Domain registry for the synthetic supplier-payment scenario: registered producers, external references that the contracts name but do not define, domain policies, commit-time precondition rules, and the target system's state. All content is invented.

external_records.ACCEPT-AP-BANK-INTERFACE@v1: Domain owner's acceptance of the weaker guarantees at the bank interface.
external_records.ACCT-AP-PAYMENTS@v1: Shared accounting ledger for payment releases.
external_records.ACCT-CHARGE-HOLD-0417@v1: Allowance charge recorded for the hold.
external_records.ACCT-CHARGE-REL-0417-B@v1: Allowance charge recorded for the second release.
external_records.AUTHZ-READ-CTX-0417@v1: Read-scope decision for the first context (principal, purpose, scope).
external_records.AUTHZ-READ-CTX-0417@v2: Read-scope decision for the revised context.
external_records.AUTHZ-READ-LIMIT-0417@v1: Permission decision: part of the requested scope is not readable by this principal; a coverage limitation may be disclosed.
external_records.AUTHZ-READ-WITHHELD-0417@v1: Permission decision: a source that this principal may not read, and whose existence may not be disclosed to them.

external_records.BASIS-AP-POLICY-V3@v1: Authority basis: accounts-payable policy v3 delegates holds to the AP team.

external_records.REVCHK-GRT-APPR-0417-B@v1: Latest revocation check for the second exact approval.
external_records.REVCHK-GRT-CLASS-HOLD@v1: Latest revocation check for the hold grant.
external_records.REVCHK-GRT-CLASS-LOWVAL@v1: Latest revocation check for the low-value release grant v1.
external_records.REVCHK-GRT-CLASS-LOWVAL@v2: Latest revocation check for the low-value release grant v2.
external_records.SCHEMA-M3W-RESULT@v1: Payload schema of a three-way-match result.

v1.summary: Accounts-payable staff may read records of an invoice under review.

v3.summary: Payment release needs a passing three-way match, current screening and an approval or a bounded grant.

v1.summary: Supplier screening must be at most 24 hours old when payment is released.
Ordinary source records are fresh for 30 days.
Policy and reference documents are fresh for one year.
A reservation is held until authoritative reconciliation.
Unknown or partial outcomes go to AP reconciliation.
Allowance is restored only on authoritative reconciliation.

AUTHZ-READ-LIMIT-0417@v1.permitted_disclosure: Coverage is limited by access permissions; no protected source identity or content is disclosed.

scope.task: Part of the requested scope that this principal may not read

jurisdiction.reason: Internal accounts-payable review; no external jurisdiction asserted.

units.reason: No unit applies to this statement.

interpretation.value: Statement of a source system or analysis as recorded; not independently verified.

gap.expected_evidence: Evidence in the requested scope that this principal may not read

reason.value: Part of the requested scope is outside this principal's read permissions.

gap.assessment_basis: Permission decision AUTHZ-READ-LIMIT-0417 applies. It allows a coverage limitation and nothing else: no source, type, count, state or age is disclosed.

attempted_at.reason: Not attempted: outside this principal's permissions.

completed_at.reason: Not attempted: outside this principal's permissions.

retrieval.reason: Permission decision applies to this principal.

AUTHZ-READ-LIMIT-0417@v1.summary: Part of the requested scope is not readable by this principal. The policy lets an output say that coverage is limited by permissions, in the words given here, and nothing else about it. Every field of the entry comes from this decision, and none from what it protects.

AUTHZ-READ-WITHHELD-0417@v1.summary: An investigation file that this principal may not read, and whose existence may not be disclosed to them. No output carries an entry, a count, a state or an age for it; it adds nothing to the coverage statement that every output carries.

accountability.summary: Four roles stay distinct. The AP controller is both the Decision Owner and the approver, and the policy says so; the requestor holds neither role for their own request.

requestor.meaning: Asks the assistant for a packet and reads it. Requests the evaluation; neither reviews on the owner's behalf nor approves.

decision_owner.meaning: Reviews the evidence and owns the release decision (the accountable reviewer).

approver.meaning: Issues the exact approval of one proposal version.

executor.meaning: Performs the authorized action after the commit check.
